name: Kameari
tagline: Tokyo in 31 minutes and Otemachi in 35 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Katsushika City, served by JR Joban Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 35 minutes to Otemachi, 49 minutes to Shinjuku, 56 minutes to Shibuya and 49 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 1.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.7 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 1.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.6 m to 1.1 m, a difference of 1.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 5 to 10 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: イトーヨーカドー 亀有駅前店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 14 clinics and 10 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 東部地域病院, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 謙仁会 亀有病院, about 7 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: JR Joban Line.
congestion: JR Joban Line runs at 142% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 三河島→日暮里; trains from here toward 日暮里 pass through it. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 2LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

Whether it faces a main road or the railway

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. In plain yen, though, it is on the low side for the 23 wards. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For safety, Kita-Ayase; for how easy the shopping is, Kameari.
neighbours.note: About 2 km from Kameari in a straight line. Kameari adds the JR Joban Line; Kita-Ayase adds the Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line. Kita-Ayase is 7 minutes quicker to Shinjuku, but times to the other main business districts are much the same. On the number of places to eat out, Kameari comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Kameari has 77 restaurants and Kita-Ayase has 11.

neighbours.lead: For safety, Kanamachi; for how easy the shopping is, Kameari.
neighbours.note: About 2 km from Kameari in a straight line. Both have the JR Joban Line. Kanamachi also has the Keisei Kanamachi Line, which Kameari does not. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On the number of medical facilities, Kanamachi comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Kanamachi has 33 clinics and pharmacies and Kameari has 27.

goodFor: People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: 環七通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 10 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the JR Joban Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: JR Joban Line trains toward 日暮里 pass through the line's busiest stretch, but at 142% passengers are not shoulder to shoulder.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
